responsibility: This Modula-2 definition module exports the large expression-building surface implemented by m2expr.cc. It specifies the foreign procedures used to construct arithmetic, relational, boolean, set, array, pointer, rotate/shift, membership, range-test, complex, literal, and size-related GCC trees, along with constant comparison and parsing helpers, so Modula-2 semantic code can drive tree construction from the language side.
same_name_distinction: Modula-2 definition module for the m2expr group: it exposes the large expression API as FOR "C" procedures and Modula-2 procedure types, unlike m2expr.h's native prototypes and m2expr.cc's implementation of the expression builders.
